This estimate is to perform a 15 foot sewer repair on the main 4 inch PVC sewer line. Allstate plumbing will utilize a subcontractor to perform the excavation once the tunnel has been fully excavated Our technicians will perform the repairs either the same day or following day.
Every 4 foot of pipe there will be hangers to help keep the pipe secured to the underside of the slab and prevent breakage or damage in the future. Once the repair has been complete an inspection will need to be performed by a state verified plumbing inspector. The tunnel cannot be backfilled until the repair passes inspection. On the day of the repair our plumbers on site will perform a hydrostatic test to ensure a leak free repair. If our technicians find other areas in need of repair while underneath the home further estimates will be provided. If the excavation crew needs to perform further structural repair on the slab or runs into any unforeseen issues further estimates will be provided. Allstate plumbing/excavation crew is not responsible for any landscaping.

- Begin by excavating an entry hole on the left side of the home where the sewer line exits the foundation.
- Then Rite Way will tunnel underneath the foundation and expose all cast iron piping underneath the foundation home owner will be paying rite way directly and Plumbing Outfitters will not be subbing out the tunneling. 
- If additional tunneling or beam penetration is needed a supplemented estimate will be provided. 
- If any more work is needed such as solid rock removal roots or any unforeseeable objects come across this estimate will be supplemented to accommodate the additional work needed to complete the job.

properties.description:
Diagnostic revealed tree roots growing into a 3x2 wye for the guest bathroom tub drain.
- Plan of action is to apply for a permit with the customers jurisdiction to legally and professionally proceed with repairs. 
- Begin by excavating the entry hole(s) at the left side of the house.
- Then tunnel underneath the foundation of the house approximately ___5__ feet to access and expose noted diagnostic issues. 
- If additional tunneling or beam penetration is needed a supplemented estimate will be provided. 
- If any more work is needed such as solid rock removal roots or any unforeseeable objects come across this estimate will be supplemented to accommodate the additional work needed to complete the job. 
- Defective drains will be removed from the plumbing system and debris will be hauled away. - Drains will then be replaced with new DWV schedule 40 PVC pipe and fittings in accordance with plumbing code. 
- Pipe will be well supported and strapped to underneath foundation to prevent the same thing happening in the future.

properties.description:
Replacing cast iron pipes with pvc pipes and running a main building sewer line to the city.

Per contractor agent 
The project involves replacing an aging cast iron plumbing system located beneath the home by tunneling under the foundation. This method allows access to the existing sewer lines without the need to disturb or remove interior flooring. A tunnel will be carefully excavated beneath the structure to expose the old cast iron pipes which have likely deteriorated over time due to corrosion scaling and potential cracking.
Once exposed the outdated cast iron piping will be removed and replaced with new durable PVC piping. PVC (polyvinyl chloride) is resistant to corrosion has a longer lifespan and provides improved flow efficiency compared to cast iron. The new system will be installed to meet current plumbing codes and ensure reliable wastewater drainage.
In addition the property will be transitioned from an outdated backyard septic system to the municipal sewer system. This will involve connecting the new PVC plumbing to the city sewer line ensuring proper alignment grading and compliance with local regulations. The septic system will be properly abandoned according to code. This upgrade will provide a more efficient low-maintenance and environmentally compliant wastewater solution for the home. 
The job will take place in the front side of the house and underneath.

properties.description:
Diagnostic revealed a leak on the tub drain for unit C and a belly on the main drain under unit C bathroom.

- Plan of action is to apply for a permit with the customers jurisdiction to legally and professionally proceed with repairs. 
- Begin by excavating the entry hole at the back of the building outside of unit C.
- Then tunnel underneath the foundation of the building approximately 10 feet to access and expose noted diagnostic issues. 
- If additional tunneling or beam penetration is needed a supplemented estimate will be provided. 
- If any more work is needed such as solid rock removal roots or any unforeseeable objects come across this estimate will be supplemented to accommodate the additional work needed to complete the job. 
- Defective drains will be removed from the plumbing system and debris will be hauled away. - Drains will then be replaced with new DWV schedule 40 PVC pipe and fittings in accordance with plumbing code. 
- Pipe will be well supported and strapped to underneath foundation to prevent the same thing happening in the future. 
- After work is completed we will then perform a static test on the entire drain system to ensure there are no further leaks. If additional leaks are found a separate estimate will be presented for the repair.

properties.description:
We will be removing the existing failing grease interceptor and installing a new codecompliant grease trap in the same general location. Work includes excavation demolition of the existing interceptor installation of new piping connections setting the new interceptor and restoring the work area to grade.
Detailed Scope:

Excavate to expose the existing grease trap and associated inlet/outlet piping.
Disconnect and remove the existing grease interceptor including damaged or noncompliant piping sections.
Install a new (Cityapproved) grease interceptor sized per fixture count and City of Austin Industrial Waste requirements.
Set the new unit on a properly compacted and leveled base.
Reconnect all inlet and outlet plumbing using approved materials and fittings.
Install new cleanouts as required by current code.
Ensure proper flow line elevations and venting per Austin Water and UPC/IPC requirements.
Backfill and compact the excavation area; restore concrete/asphalt or surface material as needed.
Perform final testing for watertightness flow and proper operation.
Submit required SAWS/Industrial Waste documentation including asbuilt information and fixture count verification.

No changes to existing building water distribution or sewer layout beyond the grease trap connections.
All work will comply with City of Austin Plumbing Code Industrial Waste regulations and Whataburger operational safety requirements.

properties.description:
Video diagnostics performed from the exterior clean-out identified approximately 60 feet of building drain with improper pitch. The issue begins about 2 feet from the exterior clean-out extending beneath the Master Bedroom Closet and continuing to the area beneath the Kitchen Faucet. The existing 4 PVC piping is back-pitched resulting in standing water throughout the full pipe diameter.

This condition occurs at the outlet of the building drain causing drainage issues that affect all plumbing fixtures within the residence.

The proposed work includes tunneling beneath the home to access and replace the affected section of back-pitched piping. The new piping will be properly graded and securely strapped to the underside of the slab to prevent future soil settlement and pipe movement.

properties.description:
Direct Access Drain System Repair

The diagnostic revealed a broken 3 wye under the stairwell. To address this we will utilize specialized equipment to create a direct access entry hole in the utility room then tunnel approximately 7 feet under the stairwell to expose the damaged area. Once exposed the defective drains will be removed from the plumbing system and all debris will be hauled away. New DWV Schedule 40 PVC pipe and fittings will be installed in accordance with plumbing code. A static test will then be performed on the entire drain system to ensure there are no further leaks. If additional leaks are detected an extra pinpoint will be required to isolate the break(s) and a separate estimate will be presented for the necessary repairs. Should additional access be required or if unforeseen conditions such as solid rock roots or other obstructions are encountered a supplemental estimate will be provided to accommodate the extra time and materials needed to complete the job.

properties.description:
Bathroom Replumb  Leak Repair Under Pier and Beam Home

Issue: A leak has been identified in the cast iron sewer stack beneath the pier and beam home specifically at the section of pipe just before it penetrates the subfloor.
Cause: The existing plumbing configuration as originally installed ties both the toilet and tub into the same leaking stack. Due to this setup and the condition of the materials a full replumb of the bathroom drain system is necessary.
Work to be Performed:
All existing cast iron piping serving the bathroom will be cut out and completely removed.
The entire bathroom drain system will be replumbed using new PVC sewer piping.
New PVC lines will be securely strapped to the underside of the subfloor to ensure long-term stability and to prevent shifting or sagging over time.
